fusions.name: Shot for the Pot
fusions.desc: Looses a heavy shaft that deals 30 piercing damage, plus 5% of the target's maximum health if it is a boss or elite. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Hunting Party
fusions.desc: A drawn shot that deals 12 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach, and knocks the target 2 tiles back. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%, and you heal for 10% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Distant Larder
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far, and you restore 10 health.

fusions.name: Game Bag
fusions.desc: Conjures a hunter's game bag: your critical chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 15% more, your maximum health rises by 10, and each kill restores 3 health.
